content.short: Coinstore is a centralized exchange launched in 2020 for spot, leveraged ETFs, perpetual futures and earn products.
content.description: Coinstore is a retail-focused exchange with a mobile-first app. After depositing fiat or crypto, users trade spot pairs across hundreds of tokens, take leveraged positions through ETF tokens, or open perpetual futures. Staking and structured earn products cover holders who prefer a passive approach. It is popular in Asian markets and often lists newer projects early. Community features include vote-to-list, where users choose upcoming listings, plus a launchpad and live streams from projects.
content.meta: Mobile-first exchange for spot, leveraged ETFs, perpetuals and staking on hundreds of tokens. Explore Coinstore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
